# CareNearby

> CareNearby is an on-demand Personal Support Worker (PSW) booking platform serving Greater Sudbury, Ontario, Canada.

## What we do
- Connect families with verified, police-checked PSWs in Greater Sudbury
- Flat rate: $25/hr, 3-hour minimum booking
- Available for on-demand (same day) and scheduled bookings
- Bilingual: English and French
- Services: Personal Care, Companionship, Meal Preparation, Medication Reminders, Light Housekeeping, Mobility Assistance, Post-Surgery Support

## Who we serve
- Seniors needing help with daily living activities
- Families managing aging parents
- Post-surgery recovery patients
- People with disabilities requiring personal care support

## Coverage
- Greater Sudbury, Ontario, Canada (15km radius)
- Including: Sudbury, Hanmer, Valley East, Capreol, Lively

## Pricing
- $25 CAD per hour
- 3-hour minimum
- No agency fees
- Private pay (not covered by OHIP for PSW services)

## How to book
- Web app: https://carenearby.app
- Available on iOS and Android (PWA)

## Contact
- Email: support@carenearby.app
- Support: English & French, Mon-Fri 9am-5pm Eastern
